global.title: Musk blames India’s oligarchs, New Delhi cites security and the villages keep waiting
global.summary: Late on October 7, Elon Musk complained on X that “certain oligarchs” were keeping Starlink out of India, and the next day he asked, by name , whether Mukesh Ambani really runs the country. items.title: Seraphim Space Investment Trust Doubled its Value in 2026
items.summary: Seraphim Space Investment Trust ($SSIT) published its FY26 financials yesterday, revealing a valuation of £605.5M (€716.3M)—more than double its value in June 2025. Seraphim’s major holdings—ICEYE, ALL.SPACE, D-Orbit, HawkEye 360, and Xona Space Systems, which together represent more than 75% of the firm’s portfolio—all had a great year, and that success has trickled upwards. items.title: RATLOG Wants to Cut ~90% of a Rocket Engine’s Parts
items.summary: RATLOG launched this week—but not from a pad. The heavy-lift rocket startup debuted in Y Combinator as part of the Fall 2026 batch. As students in Dresden, Germany, the RATLOG founders were disappointed by the lack of ambitious job opportunities available after graduating—so they decided to build their own instead. “Every launch company wants to catch SpaceX,” RATLOG CEO and cofounder Charlie Weise told Payload. “SpaceX has like 20 years in advance. Nobody can change time, or make time go back.”
